MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The calipers felt useful because I could check screw and washer dimensions when matching pieces from my hardware assortments.",
    "A compact caliper with metric measurements connects naturally to my recent purchase of M3, M4 and M5 fasteners."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing and sealed wire connectors serve wiring tasks; my recent fasteners and magnetic hooks do not imply that I currently need electrical repairs.",
    "Printer filament requires a printing project I have not indicated, while a feeler gauge measures clearances rather than the hardware dimensions I want to check.",
    "Several calipers could meet the same need, but I would choose only one; the larger 12-inch option offers more range than my small fasteners seem to require."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hardware seems to have been stretched into a broad interest in any workshop or DIY supply.",
    "The mention of electronics in my screw kit seems to have been treated as a reason to suggest wiring supplies, although I chose an assortment of fasteners."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases center on fastening, mounting and hanging, so an item's usefulness for those tasks matters more than its general association with DIY work.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear current use: one suitable measuring tool makes sense, but extra calipers and supplies for unrelated projects do not."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my need to measure small hardware but extended that interest too broadly into unrelated workshop tasks."
}
